The patented '''Head Chef Droid''' was a [[J4-SN Chef Droid]] owned by [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] members [[Gaboorga]] the Abundant and [[Duuba]] the Magnanimous, serving as [[Head Chef]] of [[The Sarlacc Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Bog's Bounty Banquet Hall]] during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Feast" />

[[File:The-Sarlacc-Pit-Cantina.png|left|250px|thumb|The Head Chef Droid working at The Sarlacc Pit cantina.]]
As a J4-SN Chef Droid, the Head Chef Droid was plated in a [[Color/Legends|gold]] coloration, with a blue [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] and four multipurpose appendages. The Head Chef Droid also wore a large custom [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Hat/Legends|hat]] on top of them. They were known for being difficult to impress, upholding stringent requirements and rejecting [[Foodstuff/Legends|dishes]] left and right, sending nothing out to the guests to the dismay of the cantina’s proprietor.<ref name="Feast" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Head Chef Droid was first introduced during the Feast of Prosperity event within the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', playing a key role in the event's "Cooking Mini-game." The Head Chef Droid's hat is modeled to resemble a real-world [[Wikipedia:Chef's uniform|chef's]] [[Wikipedia:Toque|Toque]].<ref name="Feast" />
